Problem Statement:
Stockout rates on key SKUs were running at 8%, driving lost sales, while overstock of slow-moving items tied up significant working capital.

The existing manual reorder process couldn't react quickly enough to seasonal demand shifts.
Objective: Reduce stockouts below 2% and cut safety stock holding costs by 15%.
Approach: Built a dynamic forecasting model using Prophet and XGBoost trained on historical sales, weather, and promotional calendars.
Impact Created: Cut stockouts to 1.8% and reduced overall inventory carrying costs by 6.2%.

Problem Statement: Credit card fraud losses were exceeding $12M annually at digital checkout points.
Objective: Detect fraudulent transactions in under 200 milliseconds without adding checkout friction.
Approach: Trained deep learning models to score transactions in real time using IP routing and device fingerprinting signals.
Impact Created: Prevented an estimated 48,000 fraudulent transactions and reduced chargebacks by 61%.
